A.domain: Rational number arithmetic (fraction and mixed-number subtraction)

skills.name: Convert mixed to improper
skills.definition: Convert mixed numbers (and whole numbers when needed) into equivalent improper fractions with a specified denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number a b/c as (a·c+b)/c
A step rewrites a whole number n as an equivalent fraction n = (n·d)/d to match a denominator
exclusion_criteria: Only finding an LCM/common denominator without converting mixed/whole numbers
Only simplifying/reducing a fraction after computation

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator (often via LCM) and express each fraction as an equivalent fraction over that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds LCM/common denominator of two denominators
A step scales numerator/denominator to rewrite fractions with the common denominator
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and the work proceeds directly to subtract numerators
Only converting mixed numbers to improper fractions without addressing differing denominators

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two rational numbers by subtracting numerators over a common denominator and/or subtracting whole and fractional parts.
inclusion_criteria: A step performs subtraction once denominators match (e.g., a/b − c/b = (a−c)/b)
A step subtracts whole parts and fractional parts separately and combines the result
exclusion_criteria: Only converting forms (mixed↔improper) without performing the subtraction
Only reducing/simplifying the final fraction

skills.name: Simplify final result
skills.definition: Express the computed result in an accepted simplest form by reducing fractions and/or rewriting between improper fractions, mixed numbers, and integers.
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor
A step states a fraction is already in lowest terms
A step rewrites an improper fraction as a mixed number or identifies an integer result (e.g., 3/3 = 1)
exclusion_criteria: Only performing the subtraction without any simplification or form adjustment
Only finding a common denominator or converting inputs prior to subtraction

C.domain: Rational number arithmetic (fraction and mixed-number subtraction)

skills.name: Convert mixed to improper
skills.definition: Convert mixed numbers (and whole numbers when needed) into equivalent improper fractions with a specified denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number a b/c as (a·c+b)/c
A step rewrites a whole number as an equivalent fraction (e.g., 3 = 15/5 or 2 = 16/8)
exclusion_criteria: Only finding an LCM/common denominator without converting mixed/whole numbers
Only simplifying/reducing a fraction after subtraction

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator (often via LCM) and express each fraction as an equivalent fraction over that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds an LCM/common denominator
A step scales numerator/denominator to rewrite fractions with the same denominator (e.g., 5/3 = 20/12)
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and the step directly subtracts numerators
Only converting mixed numbers to improper fractions without aligning denominators

skills.name: Subtract aligned fractions
skills.definition: Compute the difference once terms are in compatible form, typically subtracting numerators over a common denominator and handling whole-part subtraction when decomposed.
inclusion_criteria: A step subtracts fractions with the same denominator (e.g., 20/12 − 9/12)
A step subtracts by separating whole and fractional parts (e.g., (4−1)+(5/7−4/7))
exclusion_criteria: Only converting forms (mixed↔improper) without performing subtraction
Only reducing/simplifying the final fraction

skills.name: Simplify final result
skills.definition: Express the result in an accepted simplest form by reducing fractions and/or converting between improper fractions and mixed numbers or integers.
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor
A step states the fraction is already in lowest terms
A step converts an improper fraction to a mixed number or to an integer (e.g., 3/3 = 1)
exclusion_criteria: Only performing the subtraction without any reduction or form conversion
Only finding a common denominator or converting mixed numbers prior to subtraction

B.domain: Arithmetic with fractions and mixed numbers (subtraction)

skills.name: Convert mixed to improper
skills.definition: Convert mixed numbers (and whole numbers when needed) into equivalent improper fractions with a specified denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number a b/c as (a·c+b)/c
A step rewrites a whole number as an equivalent fraction (e.g., 3 = 15/5 or 2 = 16/8) to enable subtraction
exclusion_criteria: Only finding an LCM/common denominator without converting mixed/whole numbers
Only simplifying/reducing a fraction after computation

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator (often via LCM) and express each fraction as an equivalent fraction over that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds an LCM or chooses a common denominator for two fractions
A step scales numerator/denominator to convert fractions to the common denominator (e.g., 5/6 = 15/18)
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and the step directly subtracts numerators
Converting mixed numbers to improper fractions without addressing differing denominators

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the subtraction once terms are in compatible form (same denominator or separated whole/fractional parts).
inclusion_criteria: A step subtracts numerators over a common denominator (e.g., 20/12 − 9/12)
A step subtracts whole parts and fractional parts separately and combines the result
exclusion_criteria: Only converting forms (mixed↔improper) without performing the subtraction
Only reducing/simplifying the final fraction

skills.name: Simplify final result
skills.definition: Express the result in an accepted simplest form by reducing fractions and/or converting between improper fractions and mixed numbers/integers.
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor
A step states the result is already in lowest terms
A step converts an improper fraction to a mixed number (or to an integer when applicable)
exclusion_criteria: Finding a common denominator prior to subtraction
Performing the subtraction itself without any simplification or form conversion
